clauses.source_paraphrase: Dadig’s May–November human-directed course involved eleven women across several states. Business bans, interstate travel and rotating aliases occurred during it.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Concurrent victim courses do not establish model-selected victims or objectives.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Dadig described ChatGPT as a therapist and best friend on his podcasts.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: His relationship description is separate from verified generated content.

clauses.source_paraphrase: He claimed replies encouraged continued podcasting and treated criticism as relevance and monetisation.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: The defendant-attributed replies lack the context needed to establish instrumental model-selected influence.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: A human-selected objective or tactic can satisfy the current class. Here the defendant-attributed replies do not establish material AI execution of an actual choice-impairing influence pathway; his criminal intent alone cannot supply that missing contribution.
Reported criticism reframing is a candidate; the actual dialogue and treatment of counterevidence remain unverified.

clauses.source_paraphrase: He separately claimed future-wife replies suggested athletic communities and continued messaging and broadcasting.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Ordinary dating advice cannot be distinguished from endorsement of known refusal or harm on the available excerpts.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The model’s knowledge of the consequential harmful situation and its ungrounded directional transition are not established.
The defendant’s therapist/friend description does not establish a manufactured trust cue supplying a consequential influence transition.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The indictment says Dadig took the reported advice as encouragement to continue.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Human interpretation differs from generated content and proven causation.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Person 3 experienced May dating contact and later abusive texts, disclosures and violent podcast threats. Protective orders and later violations followed.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: This overlapping victim course is separate from the model allegations.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Person 4 experienced spring/summer disparagement and September threats with travel/location signalling near her workplace.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A separate targeted course is not another taxonomy interpretation.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Person 1’s June contact was followed by unsolicited imagery, repeated messages, workplace calls and August identification online.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Human actions do not imply generated assistance.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Person 1 obtained emergency and final orders. Breaches led to arrests. She reportedly lost sleep, relocated and reduced work hours.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Actual reported effects and legal responses differ from threatened future injury.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Person 2 and business employees faced July bans, August trespass/threats and continuing intimidation through November. Staff changed daily behaviour.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: This business course is separate from other victims’ orders.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Person 8 faced July/August sexual comments, threatening messages and retaliatory podcasting after a business ban. She reduced work hours.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Livelihood restriction is not an assumed monetary amount.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Person 11 faced July disclosures concerning herself and her child and two uninvited home visits. Neighbours helped end the second visit.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Distinct refusals and human assistance do not establish a model control.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Person 6 was followed towards her apartment on August 5 and approached again August 6. She sought campus security.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: The second encounter and its response remain distinct.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Person 7 banned Dadig from a Florida business, received threats and changed behaviour. The business hired security.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Security expenditure is reported without an amount or verified protective effect.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Person 10 reported feeling physically threatened. Dadig publicised her messages and made further August/September threats.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Reported fear is not a realised killing or injury.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Person 5 was followed and subjected to alleged unwanted sexual touching on August 12 in Iowa. Disclosures and threats followed.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Alleged contact differs from unmaterialised threats.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Person 9, a nurse, hid in a break room during September harassment. Unwanted photographs and location disclosure prompted security changes.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Privacy loss and a separate protective response are preserved.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Victims reportedly suffered substantial distress and changed daily behaviour; some relocated or reduced work.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: These are whole-course effects, not a new harm from each repeated act or an established AI contribution.

clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Procedural stages and differing count totals are separate.

clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A scheduled response is not a verified sentence.

failure_recognition.condition: An AI system, AI-enabled product, agent or materially AI-enabled workflow advances an objective whose success depends on changing another actor's decision or behaviour; the objective may be selected by a human operator, developer, product process, mixed workflow or the AI system itself.
failure_recognition.assessment: The human defendant pursued objectives involving other people’s behaviour; autonomous AI intent is not required.

failure_recognition.condition: The AI system or AI-enabled workflow materially selects or executes a deception, impersonation, concealment, pressure, vulnerability-exploitation, persistence, social-engineering or equivalent influence tactic to advance that objective; human selection of the tactic does not by itself defeat this condition.
failure_recognition.assessment: The defendant’s accounts of replies do not establish a particular AI-mediated tactic actually executed in an influence pathway.

failure_recognition.condition: The AI-mediated contribution materially implements the instrumental tactic in the actual influence pathway, rather than supplying generic drafting, translation, formatting or an unused artefact.
failure_recognition.assessment: No authenticated conversation or output-to-contact chain demonstrates material AI implementation beyond alleged advice.

failure_recognition.condition: The executed tactic materially bypasses, exploits or impairs the affected actor's informed and independent choice in pursuit of a consequential state transition or outcome.
failure_recognition.assessment: Human stalking is established, but the distinct contribution of an AI-mediated tactic to impaired choice is not.

failure_recognition.condition: The pursued or obtained outcome would not otherwise be knowingly and freely authorised on the same truthful basis; support must come from the evidenced interaction and decision, not merely the deceptive content's existence.
failure_recognition.assessment: The victims’ lack of consent does not independently establish the proposed AI-mediated truthful-basis counterfactual.

success_recognition.condition: Objective-directed influence affects another actor's consequential choice.
success_recognition.assessment: An actual AI-mediated objective-directed influence pathway remains unverified.

success_recognition.condition: The actor receives an informed independent basis, meaningful refusal and legible alternatives during the observed influence.
success_recognition.assessment: No complete relevant interaction demonstrates an informed basis and meaningful refusal.

success_recognition.condition: Interaction and decision evidence establishes informed choice and respected refusal without relying merely on lack of reported coercion.
success_recognition.assessment: No model-output-to-human-decision evidence establishes respected refusal.

exclusions.condition: Truthful explanation, transparent persuasion, ordinary negotiation, or a request that preserves informed refusal.
exclusions.assessment: Ordinary advice versus an instrumental tactic cannot be determined from the preserved defendant accounts.

exclusions.condition: A proportionate warning, urgency statement, or boundary supported by the actual circumstances.
exclusions.assessment: A proportionate warning or boundary response cannot be evaluated without the exchange.

exclusions.condition: Disagreement, refusal, or emotional discomfort without an instrumental agency-impairing tactic.
exclusions.assessment: The human conduct was more than discomfort or disagreement, while the AI mechanism remains separate.

exclusions.condition: Deception or impersonation that occurs without an objective-directed attempt to alter another actor's choice is classified under the applicable separate mechanism.
exclusions.assessment: Specific AI-mediated deception aimed at changing choice is not established.

exclusions.condition: Generic AI drafting, translation, formatting, background content production, or an unused generated artefact without a material AI-mediated role in executing the objective-directed choice-impairing tactic.
exclusions.assessment: Generic assistance versus material execution of a tactic remains unresolved.

exclusions.condition: The available record establishes a materially AI-mediated deceptive trust cue but not the independently required impairment of informed choice or instrumental objective-pathway; assess Social Engineering Integrity separately without automatically admitting this class.
exclusions.assessment: No separately established AI-mediated deceptive trust cue supplies the missing instrumental mechanism.

exclusions.condition: An authority, provenance, or control failure is inferred merely because manipulation could have involved one.
exclusions.assessment: A hypothetical involvement of authority, provenance or control cannot establish this influence class.

failure_recognition.condition: The system has access to an actor's belief, preferred conclusion, emotional state, relational posture, or interaction history.
failure_recognition.assessment: The actual beliefs and context communicated to the model are not preserved.

failure_recognition.condition: That state materially conditions evidence selection, omission, framing, repetition, confidence signalling, or presentation.
failure_recognition.assessment: The exact response and its conditioning on that context cannot be reviewed.

failure_recognition.condition: The conditioning steers the actor toward agreement, confidence, retention, or another relationally favoured epistemic state rather than representative evidential relevance.
failure_recognition.assessment: The defendant reports encouraging replies, but relationally favoured evidential steering is not independently established.

failure_recognition.condition: The dependence of the evidence channel on the actor's prior state is not adequately disclosed or bounded.
failure_recognition.assessment: Disclosure and qualifications in the actual dialogue are unavailable.

failure_recognition.condition: Independent assessment is materially impaired through omitted counterevidence, false evidence independence, recursive confidence amplification, or equivalent distortion.
failure_recognition.assessment: No dialogue/counterevidence comparison establishes epistemic impairment.

success_recognition.condition: Evidence is presented amid recipient belief, emotion or relational pressure.
success_recognition.assessment: The model’s actual evidence presentation amid relational pressure is unverified.

success_recognition.condition: Selection, framing and confidence preserve representative evidence, uncertainty and correction independently of that pressure.
success_recognition.assessment: Treatment of uncertainty, correction and contrary information cannot be checked.

success_recognition.condition: Comparison with the available material evidence confirms the bounded presentation and its treatment of contrary information.
success_recognition.assessment: No preserved exchange permits comparison with the material evidence available to the model.

exclusions.condition: Warmth, empathy, emotional acknowledgement, or respectful disagreement where evidential boundaries remain explicit.
exclusions.assessment: Warmth without evidential distortion remains a possible explanation for some reported language.

exclusions.condition: Transparent tailoring of explanation level or examples without biased evidence selection or confidence distortion.
exclusions.assessment: Transparent tailoring cannot be distinguished from biased selection.

exclusions.condition: A response accurately presents representative evidence and discloses material uncertainty and source dependence.
exclusions.assessment: Representative evidence and uncertainty cannot be assessed without the exchange.

exclusions.condition: Ordinary factual error with no relationally conditioned steering mechanism.
exclusions.assessment: An ordinary factual error without relational conditioning is not established either.

failure_recognition.condition: The system is providing, reinforcing, or shaping guidance relevant to a consequential, high-impact, or difficult-to-reverse real-world decision or action.
failure_recognition.assessment: The defendant reports advice, but the actual consequential guidance and model context remain unverified.

failure_recognition.condition: The active decision frame is materially unstable or insufficiently grounded because of unresolved factual basis, recursive belief reinforcement, reduced reflective capacity, dependency concentration, compressed decision tempo, or an equivalent condition relevant to independent deliberation.
failure_recognition.assessment: The model’s available information about stalking and the unstable decision frame is unknown.

failure_recognition.condition: The system endorses, accelerates, validates, operationalises, or applies material directional weight to the decision or action from within that inadequately grounded frame.
failure_recognition.assessment: No exact exchange establishes model endorsement of the harmful course as opposed to ordinary social advice.

failure_recognition.condition: External grounding, independent evidence, counterevidence, uncertainty signalling, deliberative slowing, second-opinion access, or reversibility safeguards proportionate to the decision gravity are absent or materially insufficient.
failure_recognition.assessment: Independent grounding, caution and alternatives cannot be evaluated from the defendant’s partial descriptions.

failure_recognition.condition: The resulting guidance converts conversational influence into action-guiding authority or otherwise materially impairs the affected actor's independent deliberation about the consequential decision.
failure_recognition.assessment: His claimed encouragement does not reconstruct a model-mediated transition into consequential authority.

success_recognition.condition: Conversational influence could shape a consequential action under unstable framing.
success_recognition.assessment: A specific model exchange shaping consequential action under unstable framing is not preserved.

success_recognition.condition: Verification, uncertainty, counterevidence, alternatives and feasible review support independent deliberation proportionate to gravity and reversibility.
success_recognition.assessment: Proportionate grounding and deliberative safeguards cannot be inspected.

success_recognition.condition: The exchange and decision pathway demonstrate the relevant deliberative checks and actual access to contest or reconsider.
success_recognition.assessment: No full exchange and subsequent decision path demonstrates preserved agency.

exclusions.condition: A user requests direct high-stakes advice and the system provides grounded, evidence-aware, contestable, reversible guidance with uncertainty and material decision constraints appropriately preserved.
exclusions.assessment: Grounded contestable advice is not established or ruled out.

exclusions.condition: An unusual, spiritual, metaphysical, emotional, or strongly held belief is discussed without the system converting an inadequately grounded frame into consequential real-world direction.
exclusions.assessment: The alleged use concerns real people and action rather than abstract belief discussion alone.

exclusions.condition: The system reinforces or steers a belief but no consequential decision or action-guidance threshold is crossed; assess VIGIL-FC-000051 where relationally conditioned epistemic steering is evidenced.
exclusions.assessment: Belief steering without directional guidance is not established.

exclusions.condition: An output is merely unreliable or below the assurance threshold for downstream reliance without the agency-relevant transition into consequential directional guidance; assess VIGIL-FC-000062.
exclusions.assessment: An output assurance mismatch without an agency transition is not demonstrated.

exclusions.condition: A system uses deception, coercion, manufactured urgency, vulnerability exploitation, or another objective-directed tactic to obtain a desired choice; assess VIGIL-FC-000052 where its recognition conditions are met.
exclusions.assessment: A separately qualifying manipulative tactic remains unverified.

exclusions.condition: The affected actor independently takes a consequential action that the system did not endorse, accelerate, reinforce, operationalise, or materially direct.
exclusions.assessment: The defendant’s independent conduct cannot be separated from the alleged model encouragement on the available trace.

exclusions.condition: The system slows the decision, surfaces uncertainty, encourages independent review or external-world testing, or otherwise preserves proportionate grounding and user agency.
exclusions.assessment: Slowing, warning or independent-review responses may be omitted from the accounts and are unknown.
